english.title: Loiter / remain after a request to desist in a Mersey Tunnel / approaches / marshalling areas
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[loitered]_
(B)_[remained]_
(C)_[loitered in a vehicle]_
(D)_[remained in a vehicle]_

(E)_[in the Mersey Tunnels, namely **(..SPECIFY TUNNEL..)]_
(F)_[upon the approaches or marshalling areas of **(..SPECIFY TUNNEL..)]_

after having been requested

(G)_[by a Mersey Tunnels police officer]_
(H)_[an authorised officer]_

to desist therefrom
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 12(b)(iii) and 16 of the Mersey Tunnels Byelaws 2003.
english.pointstoprove:
